# Upstream source

This directory contains the Rust source and package metadata from the published
`zune-jpeg` crate, version `0.5.15`.

- Registry: `https://crates.io/crates/zune-jpeg/0.5.15`
- Registry archive SHA-256:
  `27bc9d5b815bc103f142aa054f561d9187d191692ec7c2d1e2b4737f8dbd7296`
- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/etemesi254/zune-image`
- Packaged VCS revision: `31d81fed7551c8ccea456d9d8e2b1fd8bebb6995`
- Repository path: `crates/zune-jpeg`
- Packaged revision metadata: `.cargo_vcs_info.json`
- License choices: MIT, Apache-2.0, or Zlib. The original `LICENSE-MIT`,
  `LICENSE-APACHE`, and `LICENSE-ZLIB` files are preserved unchanged.

The source was copied from the registry package already provisioned on the
designated remote verification host. No account data, downloaded comics, external
image fixtures, build outputs, or credential files are included. Upstream unit
test code embedded in Rust source files remains part of the source snapshot.

Local changes are documented in `PATCHES.md` and the unified patch under
`patches/`. The matching pristine copies of modified upstream files are retained
under `.upstream/`; the remaining upstream Rust files are unmodified.
